title: `CEther.doTransferOut` Uses `transfer` — 2300 Gas Stipend Breaks Smart-Contract Recipients
impact: `to.transfer(amount)` forwards only 2300 gas. If `to` is a contract with a non-trivial `receive()` (multisig, vault, liquidation bot contract), the transfer reverts, permanently blocking `redeem`, `repayBorrow`, `borrow`, and liquidation payouts to that address. Funds become unrecoverable for contract wallets.
